title: Antimicrobial and antifouling conformal hydrogel coatings
killing_elements: D: polymer selected from agar, chitosan, N-isopropylacrylamide copolymer, poloxamer, poly(ethylene oxide)/poly(lactic acid) block copolymer, poly(ethylene oxide)/poly(propylene oxide) block copolymers, alginate, dextran, and copolymers thereof
killing_relationships: the aqueous pre-hydrogel solution comprises a mixture of a monomer with antimicrobial activity, a monomer with antifouling activity, and a polymer
the mixture when polymerized together forms a hydrogel
the coated substrate is contacted with a swelling agent
the non-conformal hydrogel coating is removed from the coated substrate
killing_arrangement: The aqueous pre-hydrogel solution is applied to a substrate, then polymerized, and the non-conformal hydrogel coating is removed, leaving the conformal hydrogel coating on the substrate.
what_was_already_disclosed: The prior art already teaches: a substrate having a conformal hydrogel coating prepared by applying an aqueous pre-hydrogel solution comprising a mixture of a monomer with antimicrobial activity, a monomer with antifouling activity, and a polymer, polymerizing the solution, contacting the coated substrate with a swelling agent, and removing the non-conformal hydrogel coating.
